readout.purpose: The big numbers — countdown, interval phase, clock. Spline Sans Mono, tabular figures.

readout-card.purpose: Timer-card and lap numerals, 36px, tabular figures.

body.purpose: Descriptions, forms, settings — the OS voice for everything said.

label.purpose: Buttons, taglines, captions; uppercase only in display phase labels.

motion.name: tick-breathe
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: display colons breathe at 1 Hz between opacity 1 and 0.35. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Quiet color-only transitions on interactive elements.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.note: Tool pages are one centered max-w-3xl column at every width; the display sizes by vmin.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud button per view — Start.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default button tone — transparent, 1px warm line.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Timer Card
components.description: One countdown: readout + controls over a surface card, tick ruler along the bottom. Border turns amber when done.
components.css: .ds-card-timer { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; max-width: 420px; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-readout { margin: 0; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tick-ruler { --progress: 0.4; position: relative; height: 12px; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, var(--line) 0 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: calc(100% / 40) 50%; background-position: left bottom; background-repeat: repeat-x; } .ds-tick-ruler::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, var(--ink-3) 0 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: calc(100% / 10) 100%; background-repeat: repeat-x; } .ds-tick-ruler::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, var(--accent) 0 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to right, var(--accent) 0 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: calc(100% / 40) 50%, calc(100% / 10) 100%; background-position: left bottom, left top; background-repeat: repeat-x; clip-path: inset(0 calc((1 - var(--progress)) * 100%) 0 0); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text and time inputs — surface fill, warm line, amber caret.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; caret-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: tick descends from displays that had to be read across a room, in bad light, at a glance: darkrooms, split-flap boards, stopwatch dials. The world is that instrument turned into an interface — warm black (or warm paper in daylight) as the ground, tick marks because instruments mark, numerals in a mono face because time is measurement, and exactly one amber signal for whatever is live. It refuses the two neighboring defaults: the gradient-ring focus-app dashboard and the white minimalist clock clone. There is no glass, no glow, no gradient; the dial carries the design and the amber says "running."
keyCharacteristics: Warm-black ground, one amber signal — amber appears only on what is live, done, or focused, never as decoration.
Stopwatch bezels everywhere: 60-tick dials and linear tick rulers are the only progress vocabulary; no bars, no rings without ticks, no fills without marks.
Mono numerals with tabular figures — digits hold their columns while the value runs.
Flat: depth comes from tonal steps (bg → surface → surface-2) and 1px lines, never shadows.
One authored motion: the breathing colon at 1 Hz on the fullscreen display; nothing else in the app blinks.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber marks exactly one thing per glance: what is live, done, or focused. If a second element wants amber, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Warm-Only Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are warm blacks and warm papers, never pure gray and never blue-black. Time instruments glow warm; dashboards go cool.

rules.name: The Numerals Don't Dance Rule
rules.body: Every numeric readout uses the display face with tabular figures (.tnum). Digits hold their columns while the value runs; a proportional figure in a readout is a defect.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, ever. If a surface needs to feel raised, give it surface over bg and a line border — or it does not need to feel raised.

dos: Do use amber for live, done, and focused — and nothing else (The One Signal Rule).
Do set every numeric readout in .tnum (The Numerals Don't Dance Rule).
Do express progress with dials and tick rulers — marks drawn over a ticked track.
Do pull every color, font, and radius from src/components/tokens.css; the browser chrome (selection, caret, scrollbar, title bar) takes the same tokens.
Do size display readouts by vmin/clamp, so the number owns the viewport.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass, or glow (The Flat Rule).
Don't introduce a second accent color, a cool/gray neutral, or a pure white.
Don't add a progress bar, an unmarked ring, or a plain fill where a tick ruler or dial belongs.
Don't animate anything beyond the breathing colon and state-color transitions.
Don't use a proportional (non-tabular) figure in a running readout.
Don't load a font or asset from a network origin — assets are self-hosted, and the privacy gate fails the build otherwise.
